method.status: Descriptive EDA on reused 2021/2022 development predictions, not independent evidence or tuning.
method.dependence: All cases retain 14 generators x168h. Cases overlap daily; no hourly independence or significance claims. Counts are per-case occurrences, not unique calendar events.
method.probability_primary: Micro ROC-AUC and misordered positive/negative pairs. Incident pair shares overlap across slices and cannot be added.
method.binary_note: Fixed descriptive thresholds only. No threshold is chosen for deployment; differences may reflect calibration.
method.events: Match same-direction true/predicted transitions one-to-one in temporal order within6h, maximizing matches then minimizing absolute delay. A matched event can be associated with a fragmented run. Events at observed week edges are not imputed.
method.runs: A missed interior ON run has both boundaries within hours0..167 and no predicted ON anywhere inside it; extra run is analogous. Edge-censored no-overlap runs are separately identified. No hard minimum dwell is imposed.
method.decomposition: Mutually exclusive incorrect-hour categories: missed interior ON, extra interior ON, no-overlap censored run, remaining error within±6h of true transition, remaining error farther away.
method.favourable: Input-only proxy: hourly supplied price > mean terminal water value of directly feeding reservoirs. This is not a verified optimizer switching threshold. Length truncated to supplied168h; edge-touching blocks also reported separately.
method.rank: Average tied price rank within each168h supplied week, normalized to[0,1].
method.input_interpretation: Slice AUC/rates are descriptive and confounded by generator, season, class composition and economic margin. They do not establish feature benefit.

interpretation.primary_candidate: Input-defined favourable-block duration has a stable short-block error concentration. Same-case/generator/narrow-margin comparisons reduce obvious composition differences, but do not prove a causal or predictive gain. Test features with a controlled fit.
interpretation.price_rank: No stable rank-only error concentration; weekly rank remains a cheap transformation/invariance hypothesis, not an EDA-established remedy.
interpretation.timing: Many matched transitions are exact; early/late direction is not stable between years, especially Lio. No universal time shift or hard dwell rule is justified.
interpretation.lio: Large Lio errors remain away from transitions. Negative-margin proxy hours contain both substantial ON prevalence and most within-Lio wrong-pair incidence, but also almost all available pairs, so this is not enrichment evidence. Positive-margin duration is not a demonstrated Lio-specific explanation.
interpretation.generalization_scope: This audit uses separate native historical fits for2021and2022. The latest pre2021 frozen models improve2022 vs the older frozen baseline, includingLio, as documented in reports/round3_frozen_ensemble_comparison.json. Native-refit Lio regression does not establish a universal second-year transfer failure.
interpretation.confident_slice: Confident-wrong slices use labels by construction; their within-slice AUC is tautological. Output prevalence and incident wrong-pair mass describe concentration; they are never features.
interpretation.examples: Deterministically selected high-error illustrations, not a representative sample. Price/local-WV plots alone do not explain reservoir constraints or solver decisions.
